title: Nepal Open Cup registration is live
content: Approved teams can now register for the Nepal Open Cup. Bracket previews and match schedules will update live.

title: Check-in rules for captains
content: Team leaders and coaches must be ready before match time. Missing check-in windows may result in forfeits.

title: Management workspace refreshed
content: The temporary player accounts and teams have been cleared while the new bulk approval, verification, and management workflows are prepared.
